title: Musk says SpaceX closed $40B GPU debt, warns neoclouds face shakeout
summary: Elon Musk said on X that SpaceX closed about $40 billion of mostly callable debt to buy GPUs arriving in Q1-Q2 2027, citing its investment-grade rating and Starlink revenue. He said debt markets have largely shut for firms dependent on AI data-center revenue and predicted most of the 200+ neoclouds will fail or consolidate.
reason: More frontier compute financing (F1 up), while credit tightening favours a few large players over smaller clouds (F5 up). The closing is Musk's own claim; talks were reported earlier in October.
